authorization: User authorized automatic evidence-driven component upgrades and all GPUs; retain shared 3h/8GiB limits
architecture: M4 four observation tokens (two camera projections, pooled language, proprioception),d128,4heads,one encoder and one decoder,10 learned action queries,linear7D output; no CVAE/ACT posterior

training.shuffle: all training frames; deterministic seed+epoch; drop_last=false
training.checkpoint_selection: minimum full validation FIRST-ACTION frame-weighted normalized MSE; earliest on ties, same criterion as M1
training.checkpoint_retention: initial, best, latest; resume only completed epochs with optimizer state
training.loss: masked normalized MSE across all valid K10 target steps; terminal padding has zero weight
training.initialization: fresh seed42; matched M3 ImageNet visual backbone and projection, language and state modules; new fusion/query modules freshly initialized. Do not warm start M3 trained weights.
training.comparability: 50epochs18400updates with identical anchors,K10 targets,mask,optimizer,first-actionMSE selection; M4 replaces fusion+head together. Different architecture and parameter count disclosed.

evaluation.success: LIBERO env._check_success matches returned done; no custom threshold
evaluation.preflight_rule: replay existing successful action trace and verify initial/final physical state and original success step; no new positive sample search
evaluation.scope: development pilot within known tasks, one training seed; no unseen-task or full benchmark claim
evaluation.baseline: reuse all50 accepted M3 pretrained outcomes, same reset/seed

analysis.upgrade_rule: Combined fusion/generation architecture contrast vs M3 pretrained, no attention-only causal claim. Keep outcomes even if worse; no confirmation, no automatic tuning or epoch extension. Review before choosing optional M5 or final preparation.

resources.idle_gate: two samples plus prelaunch check; no compute process; used<=512MiB; utilization<=5%
resources.old_recovery_accounting: unchanged; this is the newly requested Mini VLA baseline stage, not a reset or continuation of the old recovery queue
resources.budget_scope: Same non-reset M1/M2/M3 ledger extended to authorized M4. Prelaunch estimate gate includes full50epoch+50rollouts; leave shared remainder for independent review.

resumption: retain cache, completed epoch checkpoints and completed episode outcomes; no resampling or extra epochs because of scores
automatic_followup: supervisor terminal event to same thread; review then enqueue next frozen authorized stage; stop dispatcher when M6 reviewed complete or user cancels

pretraining.trainability: all retained backbone parameters fine-tuned; classifier discarded; no frozen feature cache

image_processing.resize_crop: reuse existing 128 bilinear cache; no center crop or augmentation
image_processing.controls: M2 -> tiny_norm isolates RGB normalization. tiny_norm -> resnet_random changes architecture/capacity. resnet_random -> resnet_pretrained changes initialization only. Same RGB normalization in all three new models; resolution differs from standard ImageNet inference and is disclosed.

resource_preflight.estimation: 1.15*(18400*train_step+2350*eval_step+240data/checkpoint+600eval/analysis); must fit stage available minus120s; exit78 if insufficient

changes: Combined replacement of MLP fusion/output with Transformer observation encoder and learned action-query decoder; identical pretrained visual frontend, pooled language/state and training/evaluation data.

idle_monitor.notifications: stage terminal events and blockers only
idle_monitor.waiting_wall_time: separately recorded by dispatcher; all experimental execution and failed attempts remain on existing non-reset ledger
